Subject: Pipeline hygiene: stage updates + owner rollouts (action matrix inside)

Team —

Quick hygiene sweep for this Monday's forecast submission (FYI: FP&A deadline Tuesday EOD). Please do the following by Monday 9am PT:

1) Open the attached Q2-pipeline-hygiene-action-matrix.xlsx and update the "Current Stage" + "Commit (Y/M/N)" columns for any deals you own.
2) For any deal you mark as RED (commit at risk), add a 1–2 line save plan and set an owner in the matrix.
3) If procurement or legal is blocking, add a target date in the "Procurement ETA" column and drop the most recent external contact.

To be clear on definitions (use these in the sheet):
- RED: <50% probability, churn/quote/PROC blockers expected this quarter. Requires executive/AM escalation and a concrete save plan.
- YELLOW: 50–70% probability, timing uncertain but still in play. Owner should run the next milestone (PO, SOW, security checklist).
- GREEN: >70% probability with contract or PO expected this quarter.

Callouts: we have 3 deals flagged with ambiguous stages — ACME (owner: Marissa), OmniHealth (owner: Sean), and ClearWave (owner: Grace). Please prioritize ACME — finance needs a clear commit or downgrade for the forecast.

Attachments: Q2-pipeline-hygiene-action-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you need to reassign owners, reply-all with the new owner and brief rationale.

Thanks — short and surgical here, we only have one shot to lock the number.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
